model: Apple Foundation Models system default; exact build unavailable
planning_scope: All cases use production system instructions and chat_tools for configured apps with no shared folders.
Calendar scenarios use actual Apple inference to select the initial read; typed data then determines the answer or reminder deadline.
Explicit note/reminder cases use shared runtime literal-field bindings; no model inference is needed for those fields or completion.
The unknown-write case starts from a saved synthetic uncertain receipt and checks the native journal guard and controller.
Normal approval, durable journal, exact fields, verified fixture receipts, completion and replay prevention are checked. Calendar reminder cases reopen SQLite and the model hub before approval.
limitations: App observations and write receipts are controlled fixtures. No personal app writes or actual destination verification were performed.
Eight bounded cases repeated three times are regression evidence, not a general task-success rate. Broad raw-helper planning still fails its separate gate.
No claim is made about unsupported event selection, arbitrary instruction grammar, live permission dialogs or other model/provider configurations.
